_readme: settings-gaps.mjs, 2026-11-15, Obsidian 1.15.0 (installer build 1.13.7) in a private headless sway (XWayland, --ozone-platform=x11). "run" is the whole first pass; its s01-view-header looked for the row on the Appearance tab and clicked nothing, so "run:s01|s06" (a fresh vault) is the authority for s01, and adds s06. The s02 steps reset the tabs imperfectly (leaves pile up between steps); read each step by where the new tab sits against the active one. In "run", s05 zzqqxx matched the note s03 had created; s06 is the no-match case.
